alex: Heads-up: reproducible on Windows CI. Electron sample shows chunk reordering + duplicate JSON after abort+reconnect.
rachel: thanks — steps?
alex: start a stream that emits ~12 SSE chunks, call controller.abort() on chunk 5, immediately open a new stream. On win-latest runner we sometimes see seq 7 arrive before seq 6, or a duplicate of seq 5 after reconnect.
omar: do you have raw frames? could be proxy coalescing or libuv differences on Windows sockets.
alex: logged raw frames (sanitized):
```
data: {"seq":1,"t":"a"}\n\n
data: {"seq":2,"t":"b"}\n\n
data: {"seq":3,"t":"c"}\n\n
data: {"seq":4,"t":"d"}\n\n
data: {"seq":5,"t":"e"}\n\n\n<abort>
[data after reconnect seen:]
data: {"seq":7,"t":"g"}\n\n\ndata: {"seq":5,"t":"e"}\n\n\n
OR sometimes: 
data: {"seq":5,"t":"e"}\n\n\n
data: {"seq":7,"t":"g"}\n\n
```
ralex: (typo) rachel: interesting. If server re-emits chunks for last-event-id we might get duplicates. But reorder implies in-flight TCP segments delivered out of expected order after abort.
omar: mitigation plan: 1) client-side dedupe by seq id with a small sliding window (last N ids), 2) accept single-newline separators in parser (split on "\n\n" fallback to "\ndata:"), 3) add small jitter (50-250ms) before reconnect on Windows.
alex: I prototyped dedupe + parser fallback in browser-sdk; local Windows VM test from 5% failure -> <1% on 500 cycles.
qa-bot: nightly-windows job queued for branch alex/sse-windows-fix  build #432 queued.
rachel: please add unit tests for: abort mid-frame, immediate reconnect, last-event-id resume, and duplicate chunk handling. Also include SDK debug flag instructions in README.
omar: add note for server team: optional `X-Chunk-Seq` header would let clients dedupe cheaply; but we'll not change server behavior yet.
alex: opened PR with tests and README update: https://git.redwood/example/prs/1234 (WIP). I also added an integration test marked flaky=true for windows-only.
rachel: sponsor the PR, add changelog entry: "Fix: SSE parser tolerance for single-newline separators and dedupe on reconnect".
alex: running 1000-cycle run now, will post results. last run logged: 2275010300 (reacted :eyes:).
